messages:
deploy-bot: [CONFIG ONLY] deploy requested by @maya

Changes:
- routing policy: add cost-aware fallback -> route.fallback="reduced-cost"
- per-route timeout: 15s -> 12s
- batching: max_batch_size 64 -> 128
- kv_cache: enable prefix caching for /chat endpoints

Canary plan: 5% for 10m, monitor latency (p50/p95/p99), error rate, and throttles.

Command: /deploy config apply sha=cfg_20260320_01 --canary=5% --canary-duration=10m

maya: kicking off at next window (03:30 UTC). please standby.
leo: pls confirm metrics & alert thresholds are in place.
samir: noted, will monitor SLOs and error budget, paging rules ready.
maya: adding rollback criteria: error rate >2% sustained for 5m OR p99 latency >200ms for 3m.
oncall-bot: alert policy created: prod.config-canary (channels: #eng-oncall, #eng-sre).
maya: also plan to pin routing table entries for model-serving nodes to avoid accidental version churn (route.pin=stable-20260319).
leo: how do we apply pin? is that a separate config key?
maya: yes, route.pin field in routing.conf — included in this config bundle.
samir: also recommend throttling bursts: set max_concurrency=500 for public routes.
leo: ack.
infra-ops: i'll run the deploy at 03:35 UTC and hold if queue depth spikes or CPU >85%.
maya: rollback command if needed: /deploy config rollback sha=cfg_20260319_09
leo: adding release note: "Config-only: cost-fallback routing, increased batching, prefix KV cache enabled, adjusted timeouts and burst throttles."
maya: do we need to notify dedicated customers? config-only so not required, but we'll update status page if any degradation.
samir: monitoring checklist: traces, 5xxs, throttles, kv-hit-rate, queue depth. attaching checklist link in thread.
maya: thanks, starting canary now.
deploy-bot: deploy started: cfg_20260320_01 canary=5%
infra-ops: first 2m looks normal. p99 latency down ~8ms.
leo: CPU on pool-3 up ~4% (expected due to larger batches).
samir: no error uptick. still under 1%.
maya: plan to ramp to 25% in 5m if stable. keep an eye on KV hit-rate target >70%.
infra-ops: ramped to 25%.
noncall-bot: alert (info): increased throttles observed on svc/chat — auto-throttle bumped, no errors.
leo: KV hit-rate currently 68% — slightly below target.
samir: increasing cache prefetch window to boost hit-rate. applying change.
infra-ops: prefetch applied.
leo: KV hit-rate 74% after prefetch.
maya: good. proceed to 100% in 10m.
deploy-bot: ramp to 100% started.
infra-ops: at 100% now. no error spikes, latency stable.
maya: canary closed, no rollback needed.
leo: merging config to main/production.
samir: will follow up with perf report and cost delta (batching effect).
maya: release note posted to #announcements and changelog.
maya: :shipit:
